answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in vault and inlet lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the meadow graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 885 impostors cost 1755 times the honest price and take 14 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
